items.title: National Biometric ID Rollout Reaches 80% Coverage
items.summary: The Ministry of Information reports that 80% of eligible citizens have now received their national biometric identity cards under the Digital Gambia initiative.

items.title: Opposition Parties Form Coalition Ahead of 2026 Presidential Election
items.summary: Three major opposition parties have signed a memorandum of understanding to field a single candidate in the 2026 presidential election.
items.author: Ebrima Sillah

items.title: Scorpions Draw Morocco in 2026 World Cup Qualifying Group
items.summary: The Gambia has been drawn alongside Morocco, Burundi, and Lesotho in the 2026 FIFA World Cup African qualifying group stage.
items.author: Kebba Manneh

items.title: Central River Region Solar Electrification Reaches 50 Villages
items.summary: The rural electrification programme has connected 50 villages in the Central River Region to solar mini-grids, serving over 25,000 residents with reliable power.
items.author: Fatou Jallow

items.title: Health Talk: New Malaria Vaccine Rollout Begins Across The Gambia
items.summary: Freedom Radio's health segment covers the launch of the RTS,S malaria vaccine programme targeting children under five in all health regions.

items.title: Lower River Schools Report 95% Transition Rate to Senior Secondary
items.summary: The Lower River Region has achieved a 95% transition rate from basic to senior secondary school, the highest in the country according to MoBSE data.
items.author: Adama Jobe

items.title: Gambia Tech Hub Secures D30 Million in International Funding
items.summary: The Gambia Tech Hub has secured D30 million from the African Development Bank to expand its incubation programme and launch a fintech accelerator.
items.author: Mustapha Njie

items.title: Brikama-Kartong Highway Officially Opened to Traffic
items.summary: President Barrow has officially opened the fully rehabilitated Brikama-Kartong highway, a 45km stretch completed three months ahead of schedule.
items.author: Ousman Darboe
